title: qChambers
description: Add some tweaks to your Trial Chambers!
body:
### NOTE: THIS IS AN ALPHA VERSION. PLEASE REPORT BUGS [HERE](https://discord.gg/yMYtQTwfD)

qChambers is a Trial Chambers tweak plugin that enhances the default experience with custom Spawner and Vault behavior. It adds configurable spawner cooldown handling, optional state holograms, vault usage limits per player, personal cooldowns, and clear visual feedback for availability, cooldown, and active use. Perfect for servers that want more control over Trial Chambers without completely changing their vanilla feel.



<details>
<summary>Config</summary>


```
settings:
  debug: false
  scan-interval-ticks: 20

spawner:
  enabled: true
  cooldown:
    enabled: true
    length-seconds: 90
  hologram:
    enabled: true
    height-offset: 1.35
    show-ready: false
    ready-text: "&aSpawner ready"
    cooldown-text: "&6Spawner cooldown\n&f{time}"
    in-use-text: "&6Spawner in use"

vault:
  enabled: true
  max-uses-per-player: 3
  usage-cooldown-seconds: 300
  hologram:
    enabled: true
    height-offset: 1.35
    max-view-distance: 10.0
    available-text: "&bVault\n&fUses left: &e{remaining}/{max}"
    cooldown-text: "&bVault\n&fCooldown: &e{time}\n&fUses left: &e{remaining}/{max}"
    exhausted-text: "&bVault\n&cNo uses left"
    in-use-text: "&bVault\n&6Currently in use"

```


</details>
